note.question: How do manufacturer return acceptance and retailer money-back guarantees interact with retail competition and contract form, and when will channel members voluntarily offer consumer returns?
note.overview: The paper combines Cournot competition, simultaneous bilateral Nash bargaining and an upstream policy game; the paper's Nash–Nash solution is retained by name.

models.method: To derive multiple negotiation outcomes under different MBG policies, we adopt a multiunit bargaining framework (see, e.g., Davidson 1988, Horn and Wolinsky 1988, Feng and Lu 2012).

sources.quote: Regardless of the contract forms and the other retailer’s MBG decision, if the manufacturer accepts the returned products from retailer i, the retailer decides to offer MBGs and returns the products to the manufacturer; however, if the manufacturer does not accept the returned products from retailer i, the retailer decides to offer MBGs and salvages the returned products by herself (does not offer MBGs) when sr > t(sr < t).
